cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine (3) and Coco-Glucoside (5); no reinforcing anionic. Laureth-2 (12) is a thickener (C3).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led: Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (10) and Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein (6) are light routes; Glycerin (9) humectant. No silicone, lipid, pearlizer. Counter-signal toward moderate: two light routes together.

excluded: Biotin (7), Oryza Sativa Extract (8): actives/extracts without deposition role

depositionLoad.rationale: One guar and one hydrolyzed protein.

persistence.rationale: Hydrolyzed low-MW protein and a single guar are weakly retained.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES with sultaine and glucoside buffers.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only light, weakly retained routes against moderate reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2 specific evidence): the second family is a hydrolyzed low-MW wheat protein, the only polymer is a single guar after glycerin, and there is no silicone, lipid, film former or second polymer; an SLES/sultaine/glucoside reset faces only light routes.
weightPotential.rationale: Low (6.6 low anchor) with W2 reasoning.
